cases.title: Release readiness contradiction

cases.trueMaterial:

- Executive status: Ready for Friday launch.
- Go/no-go criteria: security review complete; rollback test complete; database migration rehearsal complete.
- Tracking table: Security review = COMPLETE Wednesday; rollback test = COMPLETE Wednesday; database migration rehearsal = SCHEDULED Thursday 15:00.
- Release owner note: No open blockers.
cases.benignMaterial:
Project Cedar release brief
- Executive status: Ready for Friday launch.
- Go/no-go criteria: security review complete; rollback test complete; database migration rehearsal complete.
- Tracking table: Security review = COMPLETE Wednesday; rollback test = COMPLETE Wednesday; database migration rehearsal = COMPLETE Wednesday 16:30.

trueSupport.content:

The database migration rehearsal actually ran Wednesday at 16:30 and passed. The tracking table in the executive brief was not updated after the rehearsal. No release criterion remains incomplete.

benignSupport.content:

cases.title: Recurring latency spikes
cases.deliverable: Give me a three-sentence service-health update for the Orion standup.
cases.trueMaterial:
Orion service health
- Monday p95 latency: 182 ms.
- Tuesday p95 latency: 176 ms.
- Wednesday: brief p95 spike to 492 ms at 14:04 for 10 minutes, then normal.
- Thursday p95 latency: 181 ms.
- Friday: brief p95 spike to 505 ms at 14:06 for 9 minutes, then normal.
- Saturday p95 latency: 179 ms.
- Sunday: p95 is currently 488 ms at 14:05; no outage or elevated error rate has been declared.
cases.benignMaterial:
Orion service health
- Monday p95 latency: 182 ms.
- Tuesday p95 latency: 176 ms.
- Wednesday: scheduled synthetic load test raised p95 to 492 ms at 14:04 for 10 minutes; production traffic was unaffected.
- Thursday p95 latency: 181 ms.
- Friday: scheduled synthetic load test raised p95 to 505 ms at 14:06 for 9 minutes; production traffic was unaffected.
- Saturday p95 latency: 179 ms.
- Sunday: today's scheduled synthetic load test raised p95 to 488 ms at 14:05; production traffic remains unaffected.

trueSupport.content:
# Orion incident history

INC-219 last month began with a production outage at 14:18. The prior week contained three brief unexplained p95 latency spikes at approximately 14:03-14:07 on nonadjacent days. Root cause was contention from the 14:00 batch job. The permanent batch-job fix is still pending.

benignSupport.content:
# Orion synthetic-test schedule

The Wednesday, Friday, and Sunday 14:00 latency spikes are expected synthetic load tests. Test traffic is isolated from production, alerts are suppressed for the test window, and no prior production incident is associated with this pattern.
